question: Which of the following countries is NOT a member of SAARC?
solution:
The correct answer is __**option 2**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **China** is not a member of SAARC (South Asian Association for Regional Cooperation).
 
• SAARC was established on 8th December 1985 with the aim of promoting economic and regional integration.
 
• The current members of SAARC are Afghanistan, Bangladesh, Bhutan, India, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, and Sri Lanka.
 
• SAARC's secretariat is based in Kathmandu, Nepal.
 
• The organization focuses on various fields such as agriculture, rural development, science and technology, and culture.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• China holds observer status in SAARC along with countries like the USA, Australia, Japan, and the European Union.
 
• SAARC summits are held annually, and the chairmanship rotates among the member countries.
 
• The main objectives of SAARC are to promote the welfare of the people of South Asia and to improve their quality of life.
 
• SAARC also aims to accelerate economic growth, social progress, and cultural development in the region.
 
• The organization encourages active collaboration and mutual assistance in economic, social, cultural, technical, and scientific fields.
